audio.sound_design: original procedural UI and transition SFX only

beats.headline: HVAC OWNERS / YOUR NEXT CUSTOMER / IS SCROLLING.
beats.action: Oversized kinetic type lands over a cool/warm WebGL atmosphere; a mobile-site preview rises into frame as a cursor snaps to a booking cue.

beats.caption: FIRST IMPRESSIONS. ZERO GUESSWORK.
beats.action: The Northline HVAC mobile home page opens in a polished device frame. Scroll from the hero and clear booking CTA into service benefits.

beats.caption: EVERY SERVICE. EASY TO FIND.
beats.action: Tap Services; the route changes and the page slides in. Scroll through AC repair, heating, installation and indoor-air cards, then reveal a service photo.

beats.caption: TAP. CHOOSE. REQUEST A VISIT.
beats.action: Open the booking page, choose AC repair and a date, then tap Request a visit. Finish on a clearly demoed request-received state.

beats.caption: ONE CLEAR NEXT STEP. ON EVERY PAGE.
beats.action: The home, services and booking pages peel into a kinetic 2.5D stack, then align into one responsive site.

beats.headline: NEED A WEBSITE LIKE THIS?
beats.action: Transition to a clean Chronolyte AI end card; hold the website and phone number together and readable for the full final three seconds.
